Privacy

Runner Order is a free tool made by YK.Hobby for organising model kit parts. This page explains what information it keeps and why.

Without an account

Your projects, sections and part lists are saved only in your own browser. They are never sent to us. Your colour theme is stored the same way. Clearing your browser data removes them, so use Export file to keep a backup.

With an account

If you sign in, we keep:

  • Your email address, used only to sign you in. It is never shown to other people.
  • A display name, taken from your Google profile or the start of your email address. It appears on kits you share, and you can change it at any time.
  • Cloud copies of your saved projects, so you can open them on other devices. Only you can see them.
  • Kits you share, which are public, and the confirmations and reports you make. Reports are visible only to the library admins.

Visit counts

We count visits and a few anonymous actions with GoatCounter, so we know whether Runner Order is useful. The actions counted are:

  • PDF downloaded, with its layout;
  • kit picked from the catalogue, with the kit's public name;
  • project file exported or imported;
  • feedback sent;
  • social and Ko-fi links clicked.

GoatCounter uses no cookies and keeps no personal profile. It records the page, the site that sent you, your browser and screen size, and your country. Your IP address is used only to work out the country and to avoid counting a visit twice, and it is not stored. Nothing you type, such as project names or part lists, is ever sent.

Services we use

  • Supabase stores accounts, cloud projects and the kit library, and handles sign-in.
  • Google confirms your identity if you choose "Continue with Google". We receive your name and email address, nothing else.
  • Resend delivers sign-in emails.
  • GoatCounter counts visits, as described above.
  • Web3Forms delivers messages sent with the feedback form, including the name and email you enter.
  • GitHub Pages hosts the website, and jsDelivr serves the sign-in library. Like most websites, they may log technical details such as your IP address.

We do not sell your information, show ads, or use cookies for tracking or analytics.

Your choices

  • Change your display name or sign out from the account menu.
  • Delete account in the account menu removes your account and its cloud projects straight away. Kits you shared stay in the library without your name, as the Terms allow.
  • For anything else, including a copy of your data, use Send feedback on the main page.
